column1: # C#: interfaces (interface), classes (class) and methods (method). Fields and properties are
# not listed. conditional.cs is the conditional-compilation fixture: `#if` groups that cut a
# method apart (a body or `;` behind the parameter list, `=>` behind `#if`, an attribute in
# its own group) are read with the first branch of each group; a definition that exists only
# in a branch that is not kept is not extracted. Its return types are keywords (`int`, `bool`,
# `void`), because a return type written as a plain identifier is also recorded as a method.
